summary: Learn executive compensation and incentive plan design with practical modelling, governance, and reporting exercises. Enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Executive compensation training is for reward analysts, compensation managers, and HR partners shaping leadership pay. It develops practical approaches to evaluating roles, comparing market data, designing annual and long-term incentives, and modelling payout scenarios in Excel. Learners also consider vesting, share-based payment accounting principles, pay-risk controls, and board reporting when preparing a documented reward recommendation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, analyse, approve, or communicate executive reward decisions and incentive outcomes. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with compensation data or governance processes and need a stronger design and evaluation method.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of compensation, human resources, finance, governance, or performance management is expected. No programming is required. Participants should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheets and interpreting basic financial or workforce metrics. Advanced equity valuation and accounting treatment are introduced at an operational application level, not taught as technical implementation.
